The hardest part of trying a new browser is moving your things into it.

S3 Browser 2.4 brings them over when you set it up, with import from Chrome, Firefox and five more browsers. Passwords are never imported; they stay in Apple Passwords and macOS AutoFill.

The same setup connects your AI agents. It shows where to install a missing Claude Code or Codex command-line tool, or which Terminal command signs you in, and then one button connects it.

New versions arrive as signed in-app updates and install only after you confirm.

Free for Macs with Apple silicon, macOS 15.4 or later.
https://s3dat.com/products/s3-browser
